item.title: 1: Tasks
item.text:
For this lablet, fix the failing Python script that standardizes the naming convention for edge routers using RESTCONF. The current script fails to authenticate and push the configuration to the CSR1000v router (IP: 10.10.20.85). Search the Python script that uses RESTCONF for the sections marked #TODO. These are the only sections that should be modified in the code to fix the automation task.

Workstation Credentials: username:cisco, password:cisco

Task 1: Open the app.py file in the CandidateTasks folder on the desktop and complete the #TODO notes to correct the RESTCONF headers and payload.
Task 2: In the same app.py file, complete the #TODO notes to fix the request  to push the configuration to the router. Run the script using the workstation's terminal. Confirm that the script returns a 204 No Content or 200 OK status code and that the router's hostname is successfully updated to "CSR1K-PROD-01".
